what: Character and sticker pieces around the first card, once the page is scrolled more than 10px, get sucked out starting from the top at .07s intervals to their own outer positions (left ones go left rotating −90°, right ones go right tilting 20°) in .2s and hide, then snap back into place in .4s when returning to the top. With enter given, they stay hidden at first and come in after that many seconds.

options.start: Hide start point, default top -10 (pinned element’s top edge sits 10px above the top of the screen)
options.trigger: (If any) Reference element css — defaults to the element it is attached to
options.enter: (If any) Hidden at first, enters after how many seconds
options.--fx-out: Hidden position transform per piece — applied to each piece via style

use: …Card…

from.where: service.html .l-mv .c-character (six characters around the first card — they enter after the card appears and hide on scroll) · .l-learning .c-character (the reverse: they appear when the section reaches 30%)
